subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `deferred` as a public cron status and expose the new parent-lifecycle callback, classifier helpers, and expanded `subagent_ended` fields as supported Plugin SDK contracts?
rationale: The internal bug fix is valid, but the PR also creates compatibility-sensitive persistence, protocol, CLI/UI, hook, and Plugin SDK surfaces whose permanence and upgrade policy require maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep lifecycle internal
options.body: Preserve the yielded-parent fix using existing canonical task and session lifecycle seams and remove the new public cron and Plugin SDK contracts.

options.title: Adopt public contracts
options.body: Retain the new status and APIs with an explicit compatibility policy, mixed-version upgrade behavior, documentation, and proof.

options.title: Split the proposal
options.body: Land the internal lifecycle repair separately and review the public status and SDK additions in a focused follow-up.

recommendation.title: Keep lifecycle internal
recommendation.body: Preserve the yielded-parent fix using existing canonical task and session lifecycle seams and remove the new public cron and Plugin SDK contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties this person to the original yielded lifecycle semantics and recent work across every affected public boundary.
